event.text: I recommend a Counsel clinician review your results in this thread, with a same-day service-hours target. Explaining a specific value safely means looking at the actual report and what test it came from, so a general answer could mislead you. Please share the test name and result wording. If you develop new symptoms such as genital sores, unusual discharge, pelvic or belly pain, or fever, arrange clinical assessment rather than waiting for a reply.
